newsitem.title: ITALY: Telecom Italia details opt-out price.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Italia details opt-out price.

text.p: Shareholders in state telecoms service operator Telecom Italia who do not wish to keep their shares for its merger with state telecoms holding Stet will be offered 3,938.25 lire per ordinary share.
The price for savings shares will be 3,176.59 lire, Telecom chairman Umberto Silvestri told an extraordinary shareholders' meeting.
Telecom and Stet are due to merger by June this year and the resulting company is expected to be privatised later in the year.
Stet ordinary shares were 1.0 percent up at 7550 lire while Telecom shares were 0.35 percent higher at 4280 by 1455 GMT.
